title: Coarse radius bounded by the sharp radius
statement: Let $q,\lambda\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $q>2$ and $0<\lambda<1$, and set $u=\log\bigl((1-t)/t\bigr)$ when defining $r(q,t)=\sqrt{\sinh(u/q)/\sinh(u/(q/(q-1)))}$. Then $\lambda^{1/2-1/q}/\sqrt{q-1}\le r\bigl(q,\lambda/(1+\lambda)\bigr)$.
replaced: Let $q>2$ and $0<\lambda<1$. For $r_q(t)=\sqrt{\sinh(\log((1-t)/t)/q)/\sinh(\log((1-t)/t)/(q/(q-1)))}$, one has $\lambda^{1/2-1/q}/\sqrt{q-1}\le r_q(\lambda/(1+\lambda))$.
